stdout:
service root_control_prepare /dev/root-control-boot
    user root
    group root
    seclabel u:r:ksu:s0
    disabled
    oneshot

service root_control_autostart /system/bin/sh -c "umask 077; [ -e /data/local/tmp/root-control.disable ] && exit 0; attempt=0; while [ ! -f /data/adb/root-control/state/prepared ]; do attempt=$((attempt + 1)); [ $attempt -lt 60 ] || exit 1; sleep 1; done; exec /system/bin/sh /data/adb/root-control/bin/autostart.sh"
    user root
    group root
    seclabel u:r:ksu:s0
    disabled
    oneshot

on post-fs-data
    start logd
    start root_control_prepare

on property:sys.boot_completed=1
    start root_control_autostart
